label: install-application of a run-named package folder, read back, uninstall
why: T7, window-only: install-application installs into the configuration and, on a .NET Core or developer-mode environment, restarts the application, so it runs only when no other agent uses the stand. Before the run, the window operator creates two package folders, /tmp/creatio-mcp-go-window/UsrParity<run>clioPkg and /tmp/creatio-mcp-go-window/UsrParity<run>goPkg (for example with clio new-pkg; each with descriptor.json naming that package), and passes the same id with --run-id. Both sides pack the folder, upload it, back it up and install it with AppInstallerService InstallAppFromFile; the answers are command envelopes whose log lines carry each side's temporary directory, so only the exit code and the closing line are compared. Unverified until the window run: that InstallAppFromFile registers the package as an installed application that delete-app can uninstall.
